why: The 47-point checklist is a named, domain-specific performance-assessment instrument for evaluating warm fresh whole-blood collection and transfusion skills, not a general instructional element.
name: 47-point WFWB collection and transfusion skills checklist
product_description: A 47-point checklist developed by military and civilian clinical experts to assess safe warm fresh whole-blood collection and transfusion performance across knowledge, collection, and transfusion sections.

why: This is a domain-specific undergraduate ultrasound training design derived from WFUMB recommendations, with fixed equipment ratios, learner population, and implementation constraints rather than a reusable general pattern.
